_comment: Synthetic heat pumps (generator heat_pump, camber.datasets._synthetic_heat_pump; 0.105, #147), the water-source units' loop -> CAMBER Role mapping. Every column is CAMBER's own: LOOP_SWT / LOOP_RWT are the water supplied to and returned from the heat pumps in F, LOOP_PUMP the loop pump (1 = running), LOOP_SPD its speed in %, LOOP_DP the loop differential pressure in psi, OAT the outdoor temperature in F. The scenario column selects one loop per ingest run and is not a point.
